phase: ja-gen Stage 3 colloquial 20M (c40), confirmed on test in stage 4: task mode with self rescoring

search.prompt: [2 BOS, 4 CTX] + encode(context) + [5 READ] + encode(hiragana_reading) + [6 OUT]
search.beam_per: hiragana reading character position; beam 16 kept per position after dedup by token ids
search.finish: reading consumed exactly, then + log P(EOS=3) after the last token

rescoring.lm_score: same model in lm mode: BOS + context + candidate tokenized jointly, sum of log-probs from the first token diverging from context alone, no EOS
rescoring.final_score: gen_score + lambda * lm_score; descending, ties keep generation order

merge.azookey: the case's AzooKey N-best (20 for development cases, converter d59a28e4c7ca, typo off, Zenzai off; empty for hand-written cases)
merge.union: AzooKey N-best in its order, then generated top 10 in generation order; exact-string dedup
merge.gen_score: task-mode sum of log P(gen_output_ids | gen_prompt_ids), gen_output_ids = encode(text) + [EOS 3]; the prompt trims left-context tokens so prompt + output - 1 <= 128; null when the text does not roundtrip through the tokenizer or does not fit
merge.lm_score: lm mode: sum of log P(lm_ids[t] | lm_ids[:t]) for t >= lm_from; lm_ids = BOS + encode(context + text), lm_from = common prefix of BOS + encode(context) and every candidate's lm_ids in one joint call (one joint call over the candidates accepted alone when the joint call over all is refused: lm_fallback); null when the candidate is refused
merge.order: both scores: gen_score + lambda * lm_score; candidates with only one score after all with both, by that score (lambda * lm_score or gen_score); none last; ties keep union order
merge.shown: the display order; shown[0] is the first candidate
